entries.description: Invented three lemma names in one proof (lt_add_of_pos_right_ax, div_lt_of_lt_mul_local, wgc_not_lt_of_le-unreachable) and wrote an unusable contradiction. Caught by the build plus the reachable-lemma index built this morning, which named where div_lt_of_lt_mul actually lives.

findings.description: The hypothesis a cell needs is monotone in how hard the dividend pulls: unbounded needs none, vanishing needs 0<log d, merely-bounded needs 1<=log d. Four rows, one ordering. Nobody asked for it.
